one_sentence: The Cross repairs all seven dimensions of damage from Genesis 3 through structurally symmetric counter-moves at the same levels as the original attacks.
executive_summary: This document presents the capstone isomorphism of the Genesis-to-Quantum series, arguing that the seven adversary moves in Genesis 3 are exactly countered by seven structural counter-moves at the Cross. Each counter-move operates at the same level as the attack: information distortion is countered by truth incarnation, boundary violation by voluntary submission, self-exaltation by kenosis, illicit knowledge by voluntary ignorance, physical death by physical resurrection, separation by God experiencing separation, and exile by veil-tearing. The framework is falsifiable via five kill conditions, with the physical resurrection being the most critical. The conclusion is that the Cross uniquely addresses all seven dimensions of damage, making it the only event that structurally matches the Fall.
short_summary: This document is a structural isomorphism mapping seven attacks in Genesis 3 to seven counter-moves at the Cross. The core claim is that each counter-move operates at the same structural level as the corresponding attack, satisfying a symmetry requirement of repair. Key evidence includes the seven paired mappings with scriptural references and the five kill conditions that make the framework falsifiable. This matters because it provides a rigorous, testable framework for understanding the atonement as a multi-dimensional repair of the Fall.
